certainty_ladder.law: UNKNOWN IS NOT FAILURE. PRETENDING UNKNOWN IS KNOWN IS FAILURE.
certainty_ladder.on_unresolvable_conflict: state the conflict; do not guess

conflict_c3_recorded.judgment: adopt doc 09's dictionary as normative — it is what the three languages must agree on
conflict_c3_recorded.three_language_standard: the output contract (human + AI + machine form)

definitions.10/10: exceptional fitness for purpose with no known material weakness within evaluated scope and evidence. Requires: defined purpose, criteria, weighting, evidence, evaluation, critique, critical-failure consideration, verification.
definitions.AAA: highest practical quality reasonably achievable for purpose, scope, and evidence. Not decoration. Not perfection theater.
definitions.critical_failure: defect a weighted average must not hide (false information, unsafe instructions, broken primary function, security hole, lost protected work, false verification claim). May cap the score regardless of the math.
definitions.live_verified: proven in production, against the live thing.
definitions.oscar: the independent critic INSIDE scorecarding, not a separate system. Oscar seeks truth, not negativity.
definitions.verified: checked against real evidence and found to hold. Implemented is not verified.

evidence_ladder.invariant: UNKNOWN IS NOT 10. UNVERIFIED IS NOT PROVEN.

governing_rule.predicate: for every defined term, human_note.meaning == ai_spec.meaning == machine_schema.meaning == dictionary[term]; divergence is a defect
governing_rule.statement: when a term has an official Naya definition, use the Naya definition in all three tongues

language_law.never_assume: do not assume we mean what you normally mean
language_law.predicate: term in dictionary => resolve to dictionary[term] in every document, report, and schema
language_law.verbatim: WHEN A TERM HAS AN OFFICIAL NAYA DEFINITION, USE THE NAYA DEFINITION.

memory_doctrine: MEMORY IS A TOOL, NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR REALITY. Current verified reality beats memory.

naming_law.predicate: speech_to_text_variants resolve to Naya unless the human explicitly says otherwise

no_vibes_law.predicate: an intuition statement is valid only if accompanied by inspectable reasoning or a named settling evidence
no_vibes_law.statement: never use 'it feels better' as the complete quality argument

invariants: never upgrade a status without evidence
